args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Flagging some label confusion around PHL:

- Pellow Home Living (PHL) was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Could we get the saved report relabelled so the two aren't mixed up?

Thanks,
Bettina (with Sofia)

I also added a closing line asking for the saved report to be relabelled. Nothing has been sent.

Bettina, the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) is saved in the drafts box with the subject "PHL label cleanup". Nothing has been sent.

It has Sofia's bullets plus your two points: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

I added one thing you didn't ask for: a closing line asking June to get the saved report relabelled. I also signed it "Bettina (with Sofia)". Edit either before it goes out if you'd rather not have them.
